target_customer: Developers and enterprises needing document data extraction, including fintech and expense apps
problem: Manual entry of receipts, invoices and other documents is slow and error prone, and fraud on documents is hard to detect.
business_model: Usage-based API and mobile SDK, with enterprise contracts
product_category: Document AI, OCR and data extraction API

founders.name: Dmitry Birulia
education: Master's in Computer Science (2006), institution not named
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: led three engineering teams at Coupons Inc. from 2010; moved to the US from Belarus in 2009.

founders.name: Ernest Semerda
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page: led International Engineering at Coupons Inc.

technical_complexity.rationale: Accurate receipt OCR and field extraction across formats and languages with real-time speed required trained models, hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Large cloud OCR providers and many startups offer similar extraction; accuracy data helps but copying is feasible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cloud vendors later shipped document AI (blog comparisons mention AWS Textract), but Veryfi remained independent.

market_need_then: Expense and bookkeeping apps spent heavily on manual receipt entry; the founders started IQBoxy as an expense tool in 2017 (YC W17).

branding.name_origin: Company says it outgrew IQBoxy, which sent a confusing message, and used a mind mapping exercise on finance, innovation, speed and trust; the tagline Trust but Veryfi plays on trust but verify. The post does not explain the word itself.

identity.logo: Neon green and dark blue identity from a 2022 refresh with agency HOO KOO E KOO
identity.mascot_or_character: Vee, a character made by the senior designer
identity.visual_style: Neon green inspired by developer coding tools, dark blue as the warm tone
identity.voice_and_tone: Trust and speed, with the line Trust but Veryfi

branding.brand_signature: Neon green palette and the mascot Vee

rebrands.why: Outgrew the name; it confused the market about the product. Date not confirmed, a fetched post mentions an April 28 date but the year is unclear.

rebrands.to: Refreshed Veryfi brand with Vee mascot
rebrands.why: Reflect core values; agency HOO KOO E KOO

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct visual identity, mascot and two documented brand efforts, but no sourced evidence of community or viral growth.

pivots.to: Veryfi document AI API and SDKs
pivots.why: Company grew beyond expenses into broader data extraction; date not sourced

outcome_analysis: Veryfi began as the IQBoxy expense app, renamed itself and moved to a document AI API, then raised a 12M Series A in April 2021 led by NewView Capital. It claims over 1,000 organizations as customers and a team of about 70. Strong competition from cloud OCR vendors remains, and no later round or exit was found.
notes: CB Insights lists the Series A at April 7, 2021 versus April 26 in the company release; CB Insights shows 12M over three rounds. A 700K seed in March 2017 appears only on Startupintros, so unverified and not recorded. Company site did not name founders; founders come from the YC page and the IQBoxy post. The pre-batch competitor search returned only current comparison pages, so the list is empty. Date of the IQBoxy rename is unconfirmed.
